summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) end-to-end: implement vault blob v2 binary format across core, API, desktop, and web client, including a security review and code quality pass.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully with security fixes (key bounds checks, debug redaction) and simplify fixes (duplicate HKDF, double ECIES wrap) applied. A critical bug was discovered and fixed during UAT: folder sync crashed on v2 binary blobs because fetchAndDecryptMetadata tried to JSON.parse binary data. Vault migration itself did not complete for the test user — the migration IIFE failed silently and /vault/migrate was never called.

repo: orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields in OpenAPI specs — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround, not a bug
The phase 20 working directory was cipher-box-phase-20 (separate repo clone), not cipher-box — gsd-tools init must be run from the correct directory
Both apps/web/src/services/folder.service.ts and packages/sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts independently implement fetchAndDecryptMetadata and both needed the same v2 blob handling fix
vault blob v2 format is written to IPFS by the migration path, but folder sync reads that same IPFS blob — any consumer of IPFS metadata blobs must handle both v1 (JSON) and v2 (binary) formats
The CipherBox project has a TEE architecture: IPNS private keys are encrypted with a TEE public key before transmission; the TEE decrypts in hardware, signs, and discards

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed the IPFS blob — did not handle v2 binary format, causing SyntaxError on migrated vaults
Same fetchAndDecryptMetadata JSON.parse bug as folder.service.ts — both needed detectVaultBlobVersion + deserializeVaultBlobV2 import and a version branch before parsing
serialize_vault_blob_v2 originally returned Vec<u8> with no validation — changed to Result<Vec<u8>, String> with key length bounds check (key > u16::MAX bytes panics silently otherwise)
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug, which would print encrypted key material in logs — replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields
Desktop vault init ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey twice with the same public key (once for DB, once for v2 blob) — fixed to reuse the first wrap
Migrated-user login path called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs — hoisted above try/catch and reused result; also had redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair

workflow: The security:review command scope 'all phase 20 work' effectively catches issues missed during implementation — running it as part of the checkpoint flow before user verification is a good pattern

The simplify skill's three-agent parallel review (reuse/quality/efficiency) caught the orval workaround as a false positive — having the orchestrator verify against the actual OpenAPI spec before reverting changes saved time
Playwright MCP was used to automate login and observe browser console during UAT — significantly faster than manual testing for identifying the JSON.parse crash
OTPs from Web3Auth are logged in cleartext in the API dev server stdout — accessible via reading the background task output file
When gsd-tools init returns phase_found: false, check that the working directory matches the phase repo clone, not the parent project

friction: API connection error interrupted the first security:review invocation — had to re-invoke the entire command
gsd-tools init ran from the wrong directory (cipher-box instead of cipher-box-phase-20) before being corrected
orval codegen bug with nullable string fields required investigation to confirm it was pre-existing — DTO change, API client regeneration, and diff inspection all needed before reverting
Playwright browser session was cleared by HMR after the folder.service.ts fix went live — required a full re-login to verify the fix
The vault migration IIFE failed silently on first login — no error surfaced in server logs or browser console, making it difficult to diagnose whether migration ran at all
open_items: Vault migration IIFE fails silently for test user myankelev@gmail.com — /vault/migrate was never called; root cause unknown and needs investigation
